info.name: JamBase Concert Data Venues API
info.description:
REST API for concerts, festivals, artists, and venues featuring normalized data from JamBase.

Contact Support:
 Name: Team JamBase
 Email: developer@jambase.com

item.name: Look up a venue by ID

query.description: Use `true` to include the `event` node with any upcoming Concerts and Festivals for the venue.
Use `true` to suppress the `performer` node in `Concert` and `Festival` objects.

Use `true` to include external IDs for `Concert`, `Artist`, and `Venue` objects.
\
Note: `expandExternalIdentifiers` is included on Startup and higher plans and on Trial. Looking up a record by a third-party ID (for example `/v3/artists/id/spotify:{id}`) works on every plan; see [Reverse ID Lookup](https://data.jambase.com/api/docs/reverse-id-lookup).

Use `true` to include `sameAs` (i.e. links) for `Artist` responses.
\
Note: `expandArtistSameAs` is included on Startup and higher plans and on Trial. Looking up a record by a third-party ID (for example `/v3/artists/id/spotify:{id}`) works on every plan; see [Reverse ID Lookup](https://data.jambase.com/api/docs/reverse-id-lookup).

Use `true` to explicitly request past/historical `Concert` and `Festival` objects.
\
On entity-scoped historical access, including standard Pro, combine it with one of the six accepted scope selectors: `artistId`, `artistSlug`, `artistName`, `venueId`, `venueSlug`, or `venueName`. Requests without a scope selector are denied with a 403 explaining how to correct the request. An explicit all-scope entitlement removes that gateway scope requirement, but the request remains subject to endpoint validation and its independent historical window.
\
Note: `dateModifiedFrom` is a modification-date filter, not an entity scope or request for history, and cannot substitute for a scope selector.
\
Availability is tiered by plan: Trial and the free MCP plan get a rolling 1-year window, Pro a rolling 3-year window (artist/venue lookups only), and Pro+ and Enterprise include all-scope access with the full archive. Scope and time window are independent contract dimensions: a per-subscription all-scope grant widens which queries may use history but does not change that subscription's historical window.
\
On plans with geo + historical search (Enterprise baseline, or granted by request), a licensed past event-date window together with any geo parameter such as `geoCountryIso2` is sufficient, with no expand flag needed. This flag is also accepted as explicit historical intent on an entitled geo request. Geo filters alone return normal upcoming events. When an authorized historical request omits its lower event-date bound, the gateway forwards its effective fixed-plus-rolling historical floor before fetching; truly unlimited history receives no invented floor.

Number of events per page of results

The source and unique identifier for the venue(s) - venueId=jambase:62108 Use a pipe (|) to include multiple venue IDs - venueId=jambase:62108|jambase:7932731 To use non-JamBase IDs, use the source slug for the ID(s) you are using - venueId=ticketmaster:k7vGF99ORYpnS

A keyword-based search for venue name(s).
- venueName=Brooklyn%20Bowl

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple venue IDs.
- venueName=Brooklyn%20Bowl|House%20of%20Blues

For more precise venue-specific results try using `venueId` or `venue[slug]`.

Use to retrieve events for specific JamBase city ID(s) . - geoCityId=jambase:4223296 Use a pipe (|) to include multiple city IDs. - geoCityId=jambase:4223296|jambase:4224564 When using the `geoCityId` parameter, you can omit the the `geoRadiusAmount` parameter (or) set it to `0` (or) leave it empty to include only results from the city. Else, you can use a radius amount to include events within a radius around the city-center.

Use to retrieve events for city name(s).
- geoCityName=Seattle

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple city names.
- geoCityName=Seattle|Tacoma

For more precise city-specific results try using `city[id]`

The two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for a country.
- geoCountryIso2=US

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple countries.
- geoCountryIso2=US|CA

Geographic filters alone request the normal upcoming-events dataset, even on historically entitled subscriptions; dateModifiedFrom alone is not historical intent either. On plans with geo + historical search (Enterprise baseline, or granted by request), request history explicitly with a licensed past event-date window or expandPastEvents=true. For country-by-country historical backfills, prefer bounded eventDateFrom/eventDateTo windows with no expand flag needed. An authorized historical request with no lower event-date bound receives the later fixed subscription date and rolling plan/override floor before origin fetch; truly unlimited history gets no invented floor. Iterate only countries that actually have data for your target date range (ask support for the coverage list) rather than sweeping every ISO code. Note the code for the United Kingdom is `GB`, not `UK` — source data occasionally shows `UK`, but this filter expects `GB`.

The three-letter ISO code for a country.
- geoCountryIso3=USA

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple countries.
- geoCountryIso3=USA|CAN

Use to retrieve events near an IP address.\
Supports IPv4 or IPv6 values.
- geoIp=55.123.456.789

The latitude for geographic radius.
- geoLatitude=40.7505

The longitude for geographic radius.
- geoLongitude=-73.9934
Use to retrieve events for specific metro ID(s). - geoMetroId=jambase:1 Use a pipe (|) to include multiple metro IDs. - geoMetroId=jambase:1|jambase:5

The search radius for lat/lng type searches.
- geoRadiusAmount=60

Whether to use miles (default) or kilometers for radius.
- geoRadiusUnits=km

The State code in ISO_3166-2 format [[docs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2)].
- geoStateIso=US-NY

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple State codes.
- geoStateIso=US-NY|=US-PA

Note: Available for United States, Canada, and Australia only.

Must have been updated on or after this dateTime in GMT.\ If left blank or omitted, will use all updated on dates - dateModifiedFrom=2022-10-31 00:00:00 On its own, a `dateModifiedFrom` sweep only returns events whose dates have not yet passed — modifications to past-dated events never appear in a plain delta sweep. To catch changes to past shows, plans with geo + historical search (Enterprise baseline, or granted by request) can combine `dateModifiedFrom` with a geo parameter (such as `geoCountryIso2`) and an explicit past `eventDateFrom`/`eventDateTo` range. Two caveats: the historical index refreshes on a delay (up to about a day), so overlap historical watermarks by 24-48 hours; and a response carrying the `X-JBD-Geo-Historical-Fallback` header was served without past events and should be re-run after the UTC day resets. Note: Use RFC3339 format for parameter values.

Must have been first published on or after this dateTime in GMT.\ \ If left blank or omitted, will use all first published on dates. - datePublishedFrom=2022-01-01 00:00:00 Note: Use RFC3339 format for parameter values.

Use `true` to include external IDs for `Concert`, `Artist`, and `Venue` objects.
\
Note: `expandExternalIdentifiers` is included on Startup and higher plans and on Trial. Looking up a record by a third-party ID (for example `/v3/artists/id/spotify:{id}`) works on every plan; see [Reverse ID Lookup](https://data.jambase.com/api/docs/reverse-id-lookup).

Two caveats: the historical index refreshes on a delay (up to about a day), so overlap historical watermarks by 24-48 hours; and a response carrying the `X-JBD-Geo-Historical-Fallback` header was served without past events and should be re-run after the UTC day resets.
